**Limitations and qualifications:**

- Every compared free coefficient lies inside its positive printed source error width. Target-branch agreement only, conditional on the existing coupled approximate-volume fit and Table 2 priors. Prior regularization supports agreement and does not independently validate the endmembers or full spin-crossover fit. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope): Coupled three-level spin-state reconstruction using the recovered earlier observations and Solomatova Table 2 priors. The original MINUTI input, row weights, residual definition, and covariance are unpublished, so this equal-weight approximate-volume fit tests numerical similarity rather than claiming an exact reproduction.
- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.
